item.title: Today I learned why wind farms paint one turbine blade black
item.description: A Norwegian trial cut bird deaths by about 72% with one black blade but a Dutch follow-up experiment found no effect, so newer offshore farms are now trying red.

item.title: 007 First Light composers reveal their inspirations for the game’s soundtrack — ‘Our mission we set ourselves was to give the franchise a gentle nudge into the modern day, without completely reinventing it’
item.description: 007 First Light composers Joe Henson and Alexis Smith have explained how they tried to modernize the Bond franchise while retaining its classic roots.

item.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
item.description: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch....
